incidents.title: Severe Flash Flooding & Road Severance on R17
incidents.summary: Heavy rainfall runoff accumulation has breached stormwater drainage near Bridge B02. Standing water reaching 38cm depth has completely halted two lanes of Road R17, severing the primary ambulance artery to Central Memorial Hospital.

incidents.title: Substation U17 Water Intrusion Warning
incidents.summary: Water sensors report rising perimeter water level within 15 meters of transformer housing at Substation U17. Backup generator readiness confirmed.

incidents.title: Minor Structural Debris at Riverfront Promenade
incidents.summary: Tree branches and barrier dislodged by strong wind gust along Riverfront Promenade. Maintenance team PU-7 dispatched to clear debris.

analysis.summary: High confidence visual evidence of 35-40cm standing water covering Road R17 arterial near Bridge B02.

analysis.transcript: Bridge ke paas Road R17 pura paani se bhar gaya hai, gaadiyan ruk gayi hain aur hospital ka rasta block ho raha hai.
analysis.summary: Citizen voice report confirming impassable water levels on Road R17 blocking ambulance approach to hospital.
